environment.label: Environment
environment.unknownExplanation: The gateway did not say which deployment it is. Nothing here should be treated as safe to change until it does.

signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.development: This server asks for no password. Signing you in as its development admin.

error.invalidCredentials: That username and password did not match. Check both and try again.
error.throttled: Too many attempts from here. Wait a moment and try again.
error.throttledFor: Too many attempts from here. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
error.lockedOut: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. It unlocks once the window passes, or sooner if somebody with the server clears it.
error.lockedOutFor: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. It unlocks in {{seconds}} seconds, or sooner if somebody with the server clears it.
error.notAvailable: This deployment cannot sign you in. Trying again will not help; the server needs configuring.
error.unknown: Signing in failed, and the server did not say why. Check that the backend is reachable and try again.

warning.body: Nothing has been touched for a while, so this session is about to end. Anything you do keeps it.

reauth.heading: Session ended
reauth.body: Signed in as {{name}}. Enter the password to carry on. Nothing behind this has been lost, including anything half typed.
reauth.bodyPasswordless: Signed in as {{name}}. This server signs you in without a password, so carry on. Nothing behind this has been lost, including anything half typed.
reauth.signOut: Sign out and lose unsaved work

serverDown.heading: The server is not answering
serverDown.body: This back office cannot reach its backend. Nothing on your screen has been lost, and it comes back on its own as soon as the server does.
serverDown.doNotReload: Do not reload this page if you have unsaved work. Reloading is the one thing that throws it away.
serverDown.retriesLeft_one: Checking again on its own {{count}} more time.
serverDown.retriesLeft_other: Checking again on its own {{count}} more times.
serverDown.stopped: Automatic checking has stopped. Use the button when you think the server is back.

notFound.heading: There is no such screen
notFound.body: The address you asked for does not belong to anything in this back office. It may have been a link from an older version.

list.noMatch: Nothing matches the filter. There are rows here; the filter is hiding them.

reference.missing: This points at {{id}}, which no longer exists.

references.locked: Always kept. This one cannot be removed.
references.needsScope: Fill in the fields above before you add any.

delete.heading: Delete this row?
delete.body: {{name}} will be deleted. There is no undo, and anything pointing at it may stop working.

discard.heading: Leave without saving?
discard.body: This form has changes that have not been saved. Leaving now loses them.

error.missingAnyLocale: A name in at least one language is needed.
error.localeTooLong: The {{locale}} text must be at most {{max}} characters.
error.notAUrl: Write a full web address, starting with http:// or https://.
error.tooPrecise: This column keeps {{decimals}} decimals. Values are not rounded for you, because a rounded price is a different price.
error.notAnOption: Choose one of the offered values.
error.notFound: That row is not there. Somebody may have deleted it.
error.forbidden: This account is not allowed to do that.
error.conflict: That change conflicts with the current state. Read the row again and try once more.
error.validation: Some of the values were refused. The details are beside the fields.
error.unreachable: The gateway did not answer. Check that the backend is running.
error.unknown: That did not work, and the server did not say why.
error.notAnObject: Write a JSON object, in braces. A list or a bare value is not what this column holds.
error.postalCodeUnknown: That postal code is not in the national table, so it is almost certainly a typo. Nothing was written.
error.runInProgress: The harvester is working on that row right now. Wait for the run to finish and ask again.
error.brandLabelEmpty: A brand name needs at least one letter or digit. Nothing was written.
error.brandKeyTaken: A brand with this key already exists.
error.brandLinkToSelf: A brand cannot be a spelling of itself.
error.brandLinkTooDeep: That link makes a chain of spellings. Only one level is allowed.
error.brandLinkOwnsNoChain: A spelling of another brand has no chain of its own. Set the chain on the brand it spells.
error.brandLinkKeepsKey: A spelling of another brand keeps its key. Register the other spelling as its own brand.
error.brandNotLinked: Only a spelling linked to another brand can be deleted.
error.categoryTooDeep: Categories have two levels. A category inside another cannot hold categories of its own, so pick a top level category as the parent.
error.categoryNotALeaf: A product goes in a category inside another, never in a top level category.
error.itemNeedsACategory: A product needs at least one category.
error.categoryInUse: This category still holds categories or products, or a shop section covers it. Move them, or take it off the section, before deleting it.
error.categoryNotFound: That category does not exist any more. Somebody may have deleted it.
error.sectionNotFound: That section does not exist any more. Somebody may have deleted it.
error.sectionOfAnotherChain: That section belongs to another chain. A shop and a product's pins can only use their own chain's sections. Read the screen again and try once more.
error.sectionSlugTaken: This chain already has a section with that slug. Choose another one.

supermarkets.name: Name
supermarkets.externalBrandKeyHelp: The chain's stable identity across discovery runs. It is what splits Carrefour from Carrefour Express, so change it only when that is what you mean.
supermarkets.defaultPriceScopeIdHelp: The scope a shop of this chain prices against when nothing more specific holds a price. Only this chain's scopes are offered, and a new chain starts with its national scope.

locations.priceScopeIdsHelp: The most specific scope with a valid price answers. A single shop scope is always kept, and a new shop gets one automatically.
locations.label: Name
locations.postalCodeHelp: Changing this does not move the shop to another price scope. The two are separate, and the pricing stays where it is.
locations.postalCodeSourceHelp: Where the code came from. Guessed means it was taken from the nearest centroid and nobody has checked it. Empty means the shop has no code at all, which is deliberate: a wrong code is worse than none.
locations.externalRefHelp: The discovery provider’s own reference, such as node/1156230891. It changes when a shop is remapped, so it is not a reliable identity.

sections.name: Name
sections.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, unique within the chain. Written once: it cannot be changed after the section is created.
sections.positionHelp: The chain's default order. A shop with no list of its own walks its sections in this order. Leave it empty to add the section after the last one.
sections.categoryIdsHelp: The kinds of product shoppers find here. A top level category covers every category inside it. A section may hold none, and then only the products pinned to it are in it.
sections.locationCountHelp: How many of the chain's shops have this section: the shops whose own list names it, and the shops with no list of their own, which have every section of the chain.

chains.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. There is no undo. A chain that still holds shops or prices is refused.
chains.choose: Choose a chain to see its shops, its sections and its price scopes.

info.title: a chain
info.holds: A chain holds its shops, its sections and its price scopes.
info.openShop: Open a shop to set its section order, its products and the scopes that price it.

shops.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted, with its section order and its single shop price scope. There is no undo.
shops.choose: Choose a shop to see its details, its sections and its products.

info.title: the scopes that price a shop
info.mostSpecific: A shop shows the price of its most specific scope.
info.reach: A chain region covers many shops. A single shop scope covers one.

chainSections.heading: Sections of this chain
chainSections.empty: This chain has no sections yet. Its shops show products under their own categories.
chainSections.deleteBody: {{name}} leaves every shop's list and every pin. Products pinned only to it go back to being placed by their categories. There is no undo.

locationSections.heading: Sections in this shop
locationSections.fromChain: This shop has no list of its own, so it has every section of its chain, in the chain's order. Change the list below to give it its own.
locationSections.own: This shop has its own list, in its own order.
locationSections.noSections: This shop's chain has no sections yet. Add them on the chain's Sections tab.
locationSections.noneTicked: Tick at least one section to save a list. To go back to the chain's list, use the chain's default.
locationSections.grip: {{name}}, place {{place}} of {{count}}. Press the up or down arrow key to move it.

info.title: what a map does to this list
info.map: This list follows the shop's map. The next save of the map's walk replaces any change made here.

locationSections.mapNotice: This list follows the shop's map. The next save of the map's walk replaces any change made here.

mapConfirm.heading: Change a list that follows a map?

itemSections.heading: Where it is, per chain
itemSections.notSold: No chain sells this product yet, so it is in no shop's sections.
itemSections.noSections: This chain has no sections, so its shops show the product under its own categories.
itemSections.byCategories: By its categories: in whichever of a shop's sections hold one of them.
itemSections.pickLegend: The sections it is in, in this chain
itemSections.pickHelp: Pinned, the product is in these sections and in no other. Tick none to remove the pins.
itemSections.previewAt: Where shoppers find it at a shop

preview.pinned: In {{sections}}, because it is pinned there.
preview.covered: In {{sections}}, because the section holds one of its categories.
preview.none: No section of this shop holds it, so it is shown under its own categories.

priceScopes.supermarketIdHelp: The chain this scope prices for. It is fixed once the scope exists.
priceScopes.kindHelp: How wide the scope is. A warehouse scope is one price shared by every shop that warehouse serves. A single shop scope covers one shop.
priceScopes.externalKeyHelp: The source’s own key for the scope, such as a warehouse number. Text and not a number: it arrives as 4661 and as mad3.
priceScopes.label: Label
priceScopes.labelHelp: A name for people to read. Harvested scopes have none, and are shown by their kind and source key instead.
priceScopes.priorityHelp: Which of a shop's scopes it is quoted from. A shop can sell at several, and the most specific one that has a price for a product is the price that shop charges. It is set from the kind when the scope is made and changed through the API, because moving it re-ranks every shop that holds it.

sources.heading: Source products
sources.empty: No chain product is bound to or proposed for this product.
sources.name: Chain name
sources.sharedEan: {{count}} rows of this chain share this barcode

items.name: Name
items.eanHelp: The only identifier that joins a product across chains. Unique across the catalog.
items.categoryIdsHelp: Only categories inside another. The first is the one a row shows when it has room for one.
items.unitSizeHelp: Without it the unit says nothing: a liter is not a size.
items.productGroupIdHelp: What makes this product comparable with another. Empty is the ordinary state of a newly harvested product, and nothing is wrong with it.

setCategories.heading: Set the categories of {{count}} products
setCategories.help: The categories you pick replace each product’s own, in the order you pick them.
setCategories.lead: Nothing has changed yet. Every product below will have exactly these categories once you confirm.

info.title: the product list
info.tick: Tick products to set their group or categories together.
info.scope: Choose a scope in Prices at to see what each product costs there.

products.deleteBody: Every price it holds is deleted with it. This cannot be taken back.

categories.name: Name
categories.slugHelp: A stable handle that tools and decisions files name the category by: lower case words separated by single dashes. It cannot change once the category exists.
categories.parentIdHelp: The top level category this one sits in. Leave it empty for a top level category. Products only go in a category inside another.
categories.positionHelp: The order among its siblings, lowest first. Empty puts a new category last.

productGroups.name: Name
productGroups.slugHelp: A stable handle for tooling and tests: lower case words separated by single dashes.
productGroups.referenceUnitHelp: The unit this group’s members are compared in.
productGroups.synonymsHelp: Other words a shopper may use for this group. One per line.

addItems.heading: Add items
addItems.showingUngrouped: Showing products in no group. Type to search every product.

assign.heading: Move {{count}} products into {{group}}
assign.lead: Each product below moves into this group. Nothing moves until you press the button.
assign.alreadyIn: Already in this group, left out
assign.refused: Nothing moved. The request was refused.
assign.notMoved: Not moved, because the request was refused.

error.NOT_PENDING: The product cannot be moved right now.
error.EXPECT_MISMATCH: The product changed group after the review.
error.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE: The group named does not exist.
error.MALFORMED_OPERATION: The request for this product was malformed.
error.ALREADY_TAKEN: Something this product needs is already taken.
error.UNKNOWN: Refused for a reason this app does not know.

prices.priceScopeIdHelp: A price belongs to a scope and not to a shop. Every shop that prices against this scope shows this price.
prices.priceHelp: What the till charges for one pack. Leave it empty for a product priced per kilogram.
prices.unitPriceHelp: The source’s own price per reference unit. Type it in. It is never worked out from the price and the size, because the two disagree on about one product in forty.
prices.unitPriceLabelHelp: The source’s own words for the unit price, such as 100 ml, or lv for washing machine loads. Free text and not a unit.
prices.validFromHelp: Leave it empty for a price that applies from the moment it is added.
prices.validUntilHelp: For a price you know is temporary. Leave it empty for one that holds until a better source replaces it.
prices.availableHelp: Scope wide. Whether one particular shop has it is a separate answer, on that shop’s own row.
prices.sourceKindHelp: Where the shown price came from. A price you add is recorded as typed in here. It is protected for seven days against a source repeating what you overrode, and a source saying something new is shown at once.
prices.priceCopiedFromScopeIdHelp: The scope a harvest run read this price at before it copied the price here. Empty for a price read at this scope.
prices.observedAtHelp: When the shown price was last observed by its source.
prices.staleHelp: Nothing currently eligible prices this product, so the newest price anybody gave is shown and flagged. Set by the server from the price policies.

remove.heading: Remove this price?
remove.body: The {{kind}} price of {{price}} is removed from the history, and the price shoppers see is worked out again from what is left. Add a new price afterwards to correct a typo.

scope.heading: This price applies to {{scope}}.
scope.noLocations: No shop prices against it yet.
scope.none: Choose a price scope. A price belongs to a scope, not to a shop.

prices.observedAtFuture: The observed date cannot be in the future.
prices.observedAtTooOld: The observed date can go back 30 days at most.

proposal.heading: Proposed unit price: {{price}} / {{label}}
proposal.caution: Worked out as the price divided by the size. The chain’s own figure can differ, so check it before you use it.
proposal.inUse: The unit price field holds this proposal.

prices.chooseScope: Choose a chain, then a scope

productPrices.hint: Open a row to see every price behind it.
productPrices.noneYet: No price yet. A run or a person can add one.
productPrices.empty: No chain has a price scope yet, so there is nowhere to add a price.
productPrices.nothingShown: No price is shown at this scope.

because.PROTECTED_ADMIN: Shown because a person typed it in, it is held for seven days, and no source says otherwise.
because.POLICY_PRIORITY: Shown because it is the newest price from the highest ranked source.
because.ONLY_ROW: Shown because it is the only price at this scope.
because.NEWEST: Shown because it is the newest. Either two sources rank the same, or every price is out of date.
because.UNKNOWN: The server gave a reason this screen does not know.

info.title: the prices of a product
info.row: One row is the price a shopper sees at one scope.
info.open: Open a row to see every price behind it.
info.held: A price typed in by an admin is held for seven days, then sources compete again.

productPrices.followers_one: Also the price of {{count}} narrower scope
productPrices.followers_other: Also the price of {{count}} narrower scopes

pricesAt.label: Prices at
pricesAt.choose: Choose the price scope the list shows

state.label: Price state
state.note: These rows show the product name and its price only. Choose Any price to search, filter and tick products again.
state.suspended: The category, the search and the order you set do not apply to these rows. They come back with Any price.

scopePicker.noScopes: This chain has no price scope to choose.
scopePicker.noChains: There are no chains to choose from.

pricePolicies.priorityHelp: Lower wins. A leaflet at 10 outranks a website crawl at 30 whenever both are eligible.
pricePolicies.maxAgeDaysHelp: How old a price of this source may be before it stops being eligible. Empty means it never ages out. Typed in prices have none on purpose: for a chain with no automated source they are the only truth.

info.wins: One rule for each kind of source. When two sources price the same product, the higher rule wins.
info.age: A price older than the limit of its rule is out of date. A newer price from a lower rule then replaces it.
info.off: Turn a rule off to ignore every price from that kind of source.

pricePolicies.caution: Saving a rule works out the shown price of every product again. Expect a short wait.

locationItems.positionInStoreHelp: Free text for where on the shelf, such as bottom shelf by the fridges. The aisle is the shop's section, set on the shop and on the product; this note is the shelf.
locationItems.availableHelp: Whether this shop carries the product. Unset means nobody has said, and the scope’s own answer stands, which is not the same as saying no. Read only here: it is written by whoever last observed it, so the row can record which of a person and a crawl said so.

help.label: How the brand is written everywhere a person reads it. Changing it rewrites the name on every product carrying this brand.
help.canonicalBrandId: Set this when the name is only another spelling of a brand, the way DEBORAH 48H is Deborah. Its products move to that brand.
help.key: Made from the name, with everything but letters and digits taken out. It is how every chain’s spelling of this brand meets, and it cannot be typed.
help.privateLabelSupermarketId: Set this only when the brand belongs to one chain, the way Hacendado belongs to Mercadona. Leave it empty for a brand sold everywhere.

registered.createdNone: {{label}} registered. No product carries it yet.

links.deleteBody: Delete {{name}}? Its products go back to no brand, and the spelling returns to Suggested brands.

spellings.empty: No harvested product carries this brand.

suggested.heading: Suggested brands

info.what: Brand names that sources use and that no registered brand holds. The most used come first.

suggested.chainAria: {{name}}, {{count}} products. Open them in Source products.
suggested.empty: No queued product carries an unregistered brand.

register.label: Name
register.noKey: This name makes no key, so it cannot be a brand.
register.linksTo: {{spelling}} will be registered as a spelling of {{label}}, and its products will move to {{label}}.
register.doneNone: {{label}} registered. No product carries it yet.
register.chainKept: {{label}} was already registered, so its chain was kept.

bulk.full: A batch holds at most {{max}} names.
bulk.reviewLead: Each name is registered under the label written here. Nothing is registered until you press Register.
bulk.reviewEmpty: Nothing is selected. Go back to the list and tick the brands to register.
bulk.label: Label
bulk.noKey: This label makes no key, so it cannot be a brand. Type at least one letter or digit.
bulk.keyDiffers: This label makes the key {{key}}, not {{original}}. A batch registers names as they are and links nothing, so this row would stay a suggestion. Register it on its own to link it, or change the label back.
bulk.refusedKept: The refused names are still selected. Correct them and review again.

record.noSpellings: No other spelling yet. Add one here, or open the other brand and set Same brand as.

running.open: Open the run in progress: {{what}}, {{processed}} processed

info.title: How Review works
info.holds: Each queue holds what a run found and could not place by itself.
info.decide: Accept, point it at another row, or reject it. A rejected row is never offered again.

info.title: How Setup works
info.sources: Chain sources say how each chain is fetched, and whether it may be.
info.brands: Brands are the names that products are filed under. The Brands queue of Review feeds them.
info.postalCodes: Postal codes are where the harvester looks for shops.

absent.heading: The harvester does not run here
absent.body: It is switched off in production and in staging on purpose, so nothing is deployed to answer this. Runs happen on a development machine against the compose stack. Nothing is broken and there is nothing to retry.

down.heading: The harvester did not answer
down.body: Something should be listening in this environment and nothing replied. Check that the harvester service and its database are running.

blocked.service-off: Harvesting is switched off on this deployment. HARVEST_ENABLED is false, so no run can start. It is server configuration and cannot be changed from here.
blocked.chain-disabled: That chain is switched off. Turn it on under chain sources, which is application state rather than server configuration.
blocked.unknown: The run could not start, and the server did not say which switch stopped it.

info.both: A run starts only when the service is on and runs are allowed. Both are set at deploy time.
info.chain: Whether one chain may be fetched is a switch in Setup.

running.stopBody: What it has already fetched is kept. The run finishes as stopped.
running.stopFailed: The run was not stopped. The server said:

start.heading: Start a run
start.postalCodesHelp: Optional, and only for a chain that names its own shops. One code per line, matched against each shop’s own postal code exactly. Leave it empty for every shop the chain publishes: the shop list is one request either way, and what this saves is the question the run asks about each code.
start.attribution: A run's writes are recorded against the harvester service, not against you. Starting one is what is being recorded here.
start.alreadyRunning: A run is already in progress. Only one runs at a time, so wait for it or abort it first.
start.failed: The run did not start, and the server did not say why.
start.refused: The run did not start. The server said:
start.priceScopesHelp: A walk covers the warehouses you tick, and a warehouse is the price scope's own key, so the prices it writes cannot be labelled with a warehouse it did not read. Tick several: the expensive half of a walk is the product detail pass, which does not depend on the warehouse and is done once for all of them. A scope this chain's walk may not write is shown and refused rather than hidden.
start.priceScopesEmpty: This chain has no price scopes to walk. Run a store discovery first: that is what creates one scope per warehouse.
start.priceScopeHelp: A walk writes the prices it reads, so it has to be told which scope they belong to. Only asked for a chain whose source states a price and does not name the scope of each one itself; a site that prints none needs no scope.
start.detailBackfill: Read product pages for the missing EANs
start.detailBackfillHelp: A second pass over the pages this chain already has, asking each one for its barcode rather than its price. It writes no price, so it needs no scope, and it takes far longer than a walk. Only offered for a chain whose products have a page to read.
start.fileImport: A file import starts from the document itself: the file says what was observed, and you say which chain, which scope and what observed it. Drop it on the import screen.

copies.heading: Copy to
copies.help: Optional. What the run reads at a walked scope is also written to every scope in its list, of any tier, shop scopes included. A copy fetches nothing, and each scope takes one copy at most.
copies.walked: This scope is walked in this run.
copies.dropped: {{scope}} was unticked, so the scopes it was copied to were removed. Tick it again to choose them again.

details.label: Product details
details.help: A product the harvester already knows keeps the EAN and brand it was read with. Choose every product to read them again.

start.missingScope: This scope no longer exists. Remove it to save.

presets.title: Presets
presets.chooseChain: Choose a chain to see its presets.
presets.empty: This chain has no presets. Save one from a new run, or create one here.
presets.name: Name
presets.nameTaken: This chain already has a preset with that name. Names are compared without case.
presets.saveFailed: The preset was not saved. The server said:
presets.alreadyRunning: A run is already in progress. Only one runs at a time, so wait for it or abort it first.
presets.refused: The run did not start. The server said:
presets.startFailed: The run did not start, and the server did not say why.

delete.heading: Delete this preset?
delete.body: The preset "{{name}}" will be deleted. Runs started from this preset keep their record.

run.aborting: Stopping. The run is flushing what it has already fetched, which is kept, and will finish shortly.
run.paused: This tab is in the background, so the screen has stopped asking. These numbers are from the last read, not from now. Bring the tab forward to carry on.
run.pollFailed: The last read failed. What is shown is from before that.

progress.label: Run progress
progress.unsized: The run does not know yet how much work it has.

counter.pricesNote: Recorded prices are kept on this chain's source products. A price reaches the catalog only once its source product is bound to a product, so a chain still in the queue records prices and publishes none.

warnings.heading: What was dropped, and why
warnings.lead: One line per decision this run made without asking. The extractor's own lost tiles are here too, so what it lost and what the import dropped read in one place.

report.heading: What this run wrote and fetched

copies.caption: The scopes this run copied what it read to.

queue.open: Work through what this chain has queued

export.action: Export this run as a file
export.help: The file holds the products this run was the last to observe, so a chain walked again since answers fewer of them. Export the newest run of a chain. It is a read, so it works whether or not this deployment is allowed to start runs: a machine that may crawl exports, and a cluster that may not imports.
export.failed: The export did not come back. Nothing was written and nothing was changed.

revert.heading: Delete what this run wrote?
revert.confirm: Delete the {{prices}} prices this run wrote. Prices another run wrote, and prices you typed in yourself, are kept. This cannot be undone.
revert.confirmImport: Delete the {{prices}} prices this run wrote and {{queued}} rows waiting in the queue. Accepted and rejected products are kept. This cannot be undone.

reverted.done: This run's prices were deleted and every product they priced was worked out again from what is left. The run kept its status, because that is how the run ended and reverting it did not change that. The same document can be imported again.

prices.lead: The price rows this run inserted, and the rows it saw again. A later run that repeats a price takes the confirmation over, so this list can shrink.
prices.emptyForItem: This run wrote no prices for this product.

places.heading: Discovered places
places.empty: Every discovered place has been decided.
places.chainHasNoKey: This chain has no brand key, so its places cannot be told apart. Every place is shown.

info.title: What to do with this place
info.found: Discovery found this place and could not match it to a shop.
info.decide: Add it to the catalog, link it to a shop we have, or reject it.

near.heading: Others of the same brand nearby
near.none: Nothing else of this brand is near it in the queue.

groups.empty: Discovery has found no places yet.
groups.unknownChain: No chain in the catalog yet

newChain.name: Chain name
newChain.hint: OpenStreetMap does not say what language a name is in, so say it here. The chain is created, with a national price scope, when the place is added and not before.

scope.heading: Price scope
scope.declared: The run that found it declared scope {{key}}. The shop joins that scope of the chain unless you pick another.
scope.none: The run declared no scope, so the new shop gets a store scope of its own unless you pick one.
scope.pick: Pick another scope of this chain only when the run's is wrong.
scope.chainFirst: Pick the chain to choose a different scope.

match.heading: The catalog may already hold this shop
match.lead: Nothing was added. Link the place to the shop that is the same one, or add it as a new shop if none of them is.

error.matchesLocation: The catalog may already hold this shop, so nothing was added. Open it on its own to link it or to add it anyway.
error.alreadyImported: This place is already in the catalog. Its shop is removed from the catalog's locations, not from this queue.
error.scopeNotFound: The run declared a price scope this chain does not hold. Create that scope first, or pick one.
error.needsChain: OpenStreetMap does not say what language this place's name is in, so no chain could be made from it. Name the chain below, or pick one.

nearCatalog.heading: Shops of this chain the catalog holds nearby
nearCatalog.none: The catalog holds no shop of this chain near it.

entries.heading: Source products
entries.empty: Every product a source named here has been decided.
entries.openSibling: Open the row it points at

says.heading: The source says
says.openAtChain: Open the product page at the chain

entries.lastRun: The run that last saw it

filter.brandNoKey: This text makes no key, so nothing matches it.

prices.heading: Prices it brings
prices.none: No price on this row. That is not a gap: a site that prints no price gives us none, and a leaflet tile with no single unit price gives us none either.

proposal.heading: Proposed product
proposal.item: The match is {{confidence}}% sure. Nothing is written until you accept.
proposal.sibling: This looks like {{name}}, another row of this chain. That row is the one with the barcode, so it is the one to create the product from.
proposal.siblingElsewhere: The row it points at ({{id}}) is not in this queue, which usually means somebody has already decided it. Accept or create here instead.
proposal.none: Nothing in the catalog looked like it, so find the product or create it.

written.none: Nothing was written for {{name}}, because this row carries no price. That is the truth for a chain that prints none, and it is not a failure.

rejectConfirm.heading: Reject this product?
rejectConfirm.body: The row stays as rejected, so no run asks about it again. You can find it later by asking for rejected rows.

bind.heading: Point it at a product we have
bind.help: Choose the product, then press the accept button.

create.heading: Create the product
create.help: Every field starts as the source stated it and only what you change is sent: the rest is filled in from the row. The English name may be left empty, and then the product lists with a missing translation tag and a shopper reading English sees the Spanish name. Whatever the product ends up called, the name the source printed is what the next run resolves against.
create.categoriesHelp: Empty uses the categories the row’s own path resolves to. Pick one or more to override them, first one first.
create.submit: Create it and bind the row

decisionsFile.heading: Apply a decisions file
decisionsFile.lead: A decisions.jsonl written by a curation run. Every operation it holds is listed before anything is sent, and the file is applied whole or not at all.
decisionsFile.countsValue: {{creates}} new products, {{links}} links. {{reviews}} rows were left for review and send nothing.
decisionsFile.otherGateway: This file was decided against {{url}}, which is not the gateway this app talks to. Every row is still checked before anything is written.
decisionsFile.nothing: This file holds no operation to apply.
decisionsFile.name: Name
decisionsFile.refused: Nothing was applied. The file was refused at {{step}}.
decisionsFile.orphaned: Products created and then left unbound: {{ids}}.

step.UNKNOWN: a step this app does not know

problem.notJson: Line {{line}} is not a JSON object, so this is not a decisions file.
problem.noHeader: This file has no header line, so it is not a decisions file.
problem.tooMany: This file holds {{count}} operations and one request takes at most {{max}}. It is not split, because a split file is not applied whole.

error.EXPECT_MISMATCH: The row changed after the file was decided.
error.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE: It names a product this file does not create.
error.ALREADY_TAKEN: Something it needs is already taken.
error.UNKNOWN: Refused for a reason this app does not know.

imports.heading: Import a file

info.drop: Drop the JSON that a leaflet extractor, a person or an exported run made.
info.caution: The same file is refused the second time, so do not edit a file to import it again.

rejected.not-json: That file is not JSON. Check that it is the producer's output and not the PDF.
rejected.not-a-document: That file reads as JSON but has no products in it, so it did not come from a harvest producer.

hints.set: Chain, scope and source were set from the file.
hints.kept: The file names them too, but your choices were kept.
hints.mixed: Some were set from the file and some of your choices were kept.
hints.unknownLine: {{field}}: the file names {{id}}, which this deployment does not have. Choose one yourself.

imports.scopeNeedsChain: Choose the chain first. Scopes belong to a chain, so there is nothing to choose between until there is one.
imports.noNational: This chain has no national scope. Most uploads are nationwide, so create one and come back.
imports.createScope: Create a price scope in a new tab

scopes.count: This file prices {{count}} group(s) of shops itself: {{names}}. It needs no scope from you.
scopes.perProduct: At most {{most}} price(s) per product, one for each group that pays it.

imports.sourceKindHelp: What the products and the prices are stamped with, and what decides which price a shopper sees when two sources disagree. A walk of a chain's API imported here is an API price, not a leaflet price: the upload is not what observed it.
imports.datesRequired: The file carries a window, so both dates are needed. Change them freely; they apply to every product that states none of its own.

conflict.already-imported: This chain has already imported this exact document. Revert that run first, then import the corrected file.
conflict.run-in-progress: A run for this chain is already in progress. Only one runs at a time, so wait for it or abort it first.

failures.heading: The document was refused
failures.lead: One entry per product, with every complaint about it. Fix the file in the producer and drop it again: nothing on this screen edits the document.

preview.heading: What would be imported
preview.search: Find a product in the file
preview.more: Show 250 more of the {{more}} not drawn

tally.matchingCapped: Showing {{drawn}} of the {{matched}} products matching "{{term}}", out of {{total}}.
tally.refused: Showing the {{matched}} refused products, out of {{total}}.
tally.refusedCapped: Showing {{drawn}} of the {{matched}} refused products, out of {{total}}.
tally.refusedMatchingCapped: Showing {{drawn}} of the {{matched}} refused products matching "{{term}}", out of {{total}}.

shops.heading: Source shops

info.row: One row is a shop that a source names.
info.map: Map it to one of our shops, or ignore it.
info.unmapped: A run writes nothing for a shop that is not mapped.

chains.heading: Chains with shops waiting
chains.none: No chain has a shop waiting. Choose a chain above to see the shops it has mapped or ignored.
chains.unknown: Choose a chain above to see its shops.

shops.empty: No shop of this chain is in this state.

action.map: Map it to one of ours
action.ignore: We do not sell from here
action.unignore: Put it back in the queue

map.heading: Map this shop
map.pick: Which shop of ours is it?
map.notBackfilled: {{shop}} will point at {{location}}. This does not fill in what the last run skipped: the next run writes it.

candidates.heading: Shops of ours it may be
candidates.notBackfilled: Mapping does not fill in what the last run skipped: the next run writes it.

sources.heading: Chain sources
sources.empty: No chain has a source row yet. A run can only be started for a chain that has one.
sources.caution: A chain blocks a crawl that asks too fast. Raise workers and requests one step at a time, and watch the failures count.
sources.exists: This chain already has a source.
sources.adapterGone: A source can no longer be fetched this way. Choose another.

help.enabled: A run may fetch this chain only while this says yes. It says no for every chain until somebody changes it.
help.autoImportPlaces: The shops this chain names go into the catalog with nobody looking first. A shop with no position, postal code, country or chain still waits in the Places queue. This is the only setting here that writes to the catalog without a review.

stop.heading: Stop fetching this chain?
stop.body: No run may fetch {{name}} until somebody lets it be fetched again.

allow.heading: Let this chain be fetched?
allow.body: A run may then fetch {{name}} from its storefront. This starts no run by itself.

config.hint: Adapter specific settings, as JSON. An empty box means no settings at all. The harvester reads this when a run starts, so a value that is wrong is found by the run rather than here.

field.autoImportPlaces: Places are added with no review

sources.osmAlways: OpenStreetMap is always asked for every postal code. It has no row here.

discoverAgain.heading: Queue this postal code again?
discoverAgain.body: This puts {{name}} back in the queue and ignores the thirty day wait, which is the only reason to press it. It fetches from a public service when its turn comes. The queue runs one code at a time, so the code is queued and not started.

notice.notDraining: Harvesting is switched off in this deployment, so codes queue here and nothing runs them. Adding and queueing still works, and the backlog is picked up wherever harvesting is on.
notice.demandUnavailable: The people waiting column could not be read, so it is empty. An empty cell here does not mean nobody is waiting.

add.heading: Add postal codes

info.looks: The harvester looks for shops in each code you add.
info.refused: A code that is not in the national table is refused, and the others are still added.

add.codesHelp: One or many. Separate them with spaces, commas or new lines. Repeats are dropped.
add.discoverNowHelp: Off adds the code and queues no run, so it is tracked and costs nothing today.
add.added: Added {{added}} of {{total}}. The refused ones are still in the box, so you can fix them and press again.

detail.lastRun: Open the run that produced this
detail.locatedInItSays: Places whose own postal code is this one, whichever run found them. This is what a shopper here would be offered.
detail.foundByItsRunsSays: Places the runs for this code wrote, wherever they turned out to be. A run centred here reaches into the codes around it, so this counts the work the code caused.
detail.nearSays: Measured centre to centre, so two codes that touch can be far apart here. A code that is missing from this list is not proof that it is far away: it may simply be outside the range we asked for.
detail.notShipped: This code is not in the national table at all, which usually means it does not exist. That is why we have no neighbours for it, and why a run for it would fail.
detail.noNear: No other code is within range of this one.
detail.noPlaces: No discovered place sits in this code.
detail.derived: Code guessed from the nearest centre
detail.tagged: Code taken from the map data
detail.openPlaces: Open the places queue for this code

waiting.suppressed: {{count}} profiles were offered this code and removed it. They are not waiting on it.

info.title: Shoppers
info.zone: A zone is a household. It holds its members and its lists.
info.person: A person is in one or more zones and owns their shopping lists.

people.zoneCaution: Everybody in the zone sees a change here at once.

users.choose: Choose a person to see their account.
users.noZones: This person is not in any zone.
users.zonesUnavailable: The zones could not be read.

resendVerification.heading: Send the confirmation email again?
resendVerification.body: A new confirmation email goes to {{email}}, the address on {{name}}'s account. This skips the wait an ordinary resend has to sit through.

deleteAccount.heading: Delete this account?
deleteAccount.body: {{name}}'s identity is removed and their shopping lists are deleted. Any zone they own is marked for deletion, and their memberships are retired with the name they used in each zone scrubbed. What they wrote on other people's lists stays. There is no undo.

grantRole.heading: Give this account a role?
grantRole.body: {{role}}: {{grants}} {{name}}’s account gets it at its next token refresh, within 15 minutes.

removeRole.heading: Take a role from this account?
removeRole.body: {{role}}: {{grants}} {{name}}’s account loses it at its next token refresh, within 15 minutes.

users.usernameHelp: The handle this person is known by. Changing it reaches every zone they are in: the name on each of their memberships is rewritten to match, so this is not a private label.
users.displayNameHelp: Whatever the sign in provider supplied, which for a Google account is somebody’s real full name. It is kept off every listing for that reason, and clearing it is allowed.
users.emailHelp: Fixed here. Nothing in velista changes a registered address, so there is no service to call: the four paths that write it each establish an identity, and writing the column alone would leave the credential, any linked provider and every outstanding confirmation pointing at an address the account no longer claims. Use “Resend confirmation” for an unconfirmed one.
users.emailVerifiedAtHelp: Fixed here. Setting it by hand asserts that somebody proved control of an address, which is the one thing this column exists to record and the one thing an operator cannot observe.
users.kindHelp: Fixed here. A temporary account becomes registered by upgrading, which needs a password or a linked provider and writes a credential in the same transaction; flipping the value alone would leave an account nobody can sign in to. Nothing goes the other way at all.

roles.label: Roles
roles.guest: A guest account holds no roles. Once it registers, its roles can be set here.
roles.guestRefused: A guest account holds no roles, so the server refused. Set them once the account has registered.
roles.saved: Saved. The account sees the change at its next token refresh, within 15 minutes.

users.rolesHelp: Set on the Details tab of the person, one role at a time and each confirmed. A role grants permissions in velista, which reach the account within 15 minutes.

zones.name: Name
zones.choose: Choose a zone to see its members and its lists.

regenerateJoinCode.heading: Replace the join code?
regenerateJoinCode.body: {{name}} gets a new join code. Anybody holding the old one can no longer use it, including a link somebody was sent an hour ago.

deleteZone.heading: Delete this zone?
deleteZone.body: {{name}} is deleted, with its lists, its lines and everything settled inside it. Every member loses it from their app. There is no undo.

markForDeletion.heading: Mark this zone for deletion?
markForDeletion.body: {{name}} is put in the queue the reaper works through, and is removed for good once the grace period is up. Restoring it before then undoes this.

zones.configHelp: The zone’s own configuration, as a JSON object. It is replaced whole rather than merged, which is what saving does for the zone’s owner too.
zones.ownerHelp: Fixed here. Handing the zone to somebody is “Make owner” in a member’s menu on the Members tab, because it is two role changes and this value in one transaction. A zone with no owner is an ordinary state, and that action is what rescues it.
zones.joinCodeHelp: Fixed here. It is unique and random on purpose, so it is minted rather than typed: “New join code” replaces it and invalidates every invitation already handed out.
zones.statusHelp: Fixed here. It is written together with “Marked for deletion” in one transaction, and “Mark for deletion” and “Restore” on the zone’s page are how it moves. Writing one of the pair alone leaves a zone the reaper either never removes or removes anyway.
zones.markedForDeletionAtHelp: Fixed here, and the other half of the pair above. “Mark for deletion” sets both and “Restore” clears both.
zones.memberCountHelp: Counted from the members who are in the zone. Add or remove a member to change it.
zones.listCountHelp: Counted from the lists of the zone. Add or remove a list to change it.
zones.pendingCountHelp: Counted from the people who asked to join and wait for an answer. Approve or reject a request on the Members tab to change it.

lists.name: Name

info.title: Lists
info.adds: Only a member of the zone adds one.

lists.zoneHelp: Fixed here. A list belongs to the zone it was made in, and nothing moves one between zones.
lists.createdByUserIdHelp: Fixed here. It records who made the list, which is a fact about what happened rather than a setting.
lists.lineCountHelp: Counted from the lines of the list. A member adds a line, and deleting one here lowers it.
lists.autoApproveLinesHelp: Whether a line added from now on counts straight away. It governs new lines only, so turning it on approves nothing that is already waiting.
lists.sharedWithZoneHelp: Turning this on gives every approved member of the zone the right to read this list, write on it and decide its lines. Turning it off takes that right from nobody. It governs who arrives next, so switching it off does not close the list: to shut somebody out, remove them from the zone.

baskets.name: Name
baskets.noLines: This shopping list shows no rows.

info.title: Shopping lists
info.record: A shopping list is the record of one trip, so it is read only.
info.correct: To correct something, change the list it came from.

failed.none: No failed sign in has been recorded.

info.readOnly: This list is read only. An admin is added on the server, not here.
info.add: To add one, run this where kubectl reaches the cluster. It asks for the password.
info.addLocal: To add one, run this at the root of the repository. It asks for the password.

field.idHelp: The identifier this row is addressed by. It is generated when the row is created and nothing changes it.
field.createdAtHelp: When the row was created. It records what happened and is never rewritten.

memberships.zoneIdHelp: Fixed here. A membership is one person in one zone; somebody joining a second zone gets a second membership.
memberships.zoneNameHelp: The household this membership is in.
memberships.userIdHelp: Fixed here. It says whose membership this is, and nothing transfers one between accounts.
memberships.usernameHelp: What this person is called inside this zone alone. Their global handle is on their account and is not touched by this.
memberships.roleHelp: Owner is deliberately not offered. Handing the zone over is “Make owner” in the member’s menu on the Members tab, because it is two role changes and the zone’s owner in one transaction.
memberships.statusHelp: Fixed here. The actions on the Members tab of the zone are how it moves, because each of them does more than write this value: approving somebody announces it to the zone, banning keeps the row so the ban survives, and rejecting removes it.

transfer.heading: Hand the zone over?
transfer.body: {{name}} becomes the owner of the zone. Whoever owns it now becomes an admin instead.

approve.heading: Let this person in?
approve.body: {{name}} becomes a member of the zone and can read and write its lists straight away. The zone is told, so everybody with the app open sees them arrive.

reject.heading: Reject this request?
reject.body: {{name}} stops waiting and the request is removed. They can ask again with the join code.

kick.heading: Remove this member?
kick.body: {{name}} loses the zone from their app. They can join again with the code, so ban them instead if that is not what you want.

ban.heading: Ban this member?
ban.body: {{name}} loses the zone and cannot rejoin with the code. What they already wrote on its lists stays.

lines.listIdHelp: Fixed here. A line belongs to the list it was written on, and nothing moves one between lists.
lines.listNameHelp: The list this line was written on.
lines.approvalStatusHelp: Fixed here. “Approve” and “Reject” beside the line on its list’s page are how it moves, because each tells the zone. Correcting the wording above leaves an approved line approved.
lines.createdByUserIdHelp: Fixed here. It records who wrote the line, and an operator did not.

approve.heading: Approve this line?
approve.body: “{{name}}” starts counting towards the shopping. Everybody in the zone sees it change.

reject.heading: Reject this line?
reject.body: “{{name}}” stops counting towards the shopping. It stays on the list, and somebody in the zone can approve it again.

dashboard.heading: Overview
dashboard.stale: The last refresh failed, so these numbers are older than the time shown.

error.heading: The dashboard could not be read

down.body: Everything else on this page is current. This part of it is missing rather than empty.

waiting.loginFailures: Failed admin sign ins, last 24 hours

catalog.pricesWritten_one: Prices written each day, last {{count}} day
catalog.pricesWritten_other: Prices written each day, last {{count}} days

shoppers.signUpsTitle_one: Sign ups each day, last {{count}} day
shoppers.signUpsTitle_other: Sign ups each day, last {{count}} days

locked.fromAddress: Set by where you came from

state.noAnswer: The gateway did not answer, so this {{name}} could not be read.

missing.heading: {{name}} not found
missing.body: This {{name}} is not here. It was deleted, or the link is old.

leave.body_one: You changed {{count}} field of {{name}}. It is lost if you leave.
leave.body_other: You changed {{count}} fields of {{name}}. They are lost if you leave.
leave.bodyNew_one: You filled in {{count}} field of a new {{name}}. It is lost if you leave.
leave.bodyNew_other: You filled in {{count}} fields of a new {{name}}. They are lost if you leave.

value.gone: This points at a record that is gone

collection.failed: This list could not be read.

save.missing_one: * Required. {{count}} required field is still empty.
save.missing_other: * Required. {{count}} required fields are still empty.
save.invalid_one: Not saved. {{count}} field needs a look.
save.invalid_other: Not saved. {{count}} fields need a look.
